metrics.label: ARR
metrics.definition: Annual recurring revenue: starting ARR + new + expansion − churned, at period end.

metrics.label: Pipeline coverage
metrics.definition: Open pipeline created in period ÷ new ARR closed in period.

metrics.label: CAC payback
metrics.definition: Sales & marketing spend ÷ (new ARR × gross margin), expressed in months.

metrics.label: Net revenue retention
metrics.definition: (starting ARR + expansion − churned) ÷ starting ARR. Treatment of downgrades and cross-sell is not agreed.

metrics.label: Magic number
metrics.definition: Net new ARR ÷ prior-period sales & marketing spend. Prior-period definition is not agreed.

boards.title: Executive review
boards.summary: The standing quarterly read: growth, retention, efficiency.

boards.title: EMEA watch
boards.summary: Standing regional read for the EMEA leadership sync.
